title: Difference sets in abelian groups whose existence is unknown
keeper: D. Gordon, La Jolla Difference Set Repository (dmgordon.org/difference-sets; data on Zenodo, CC BY 4.0)
revision: ds.json of the La Jolla Difference Set Repository, release 1.3 (Zenodo record 19740740; dmgordo/difference-sets at c089b4d), downloaded 15 Nov 2026 12:17 UTC

template.title: ({v},{k},{l}) difference set in {group}
template.statement: Find {k} distinct elements of the abelian group G = {group} (written {primary}) such that every nonzero element of G is a difference of two of them in exactly {l} ways: a ({v},{k},{l}) difference set in G.
template.submission: Text file: {k} lines, one element per line as its coordinates in {primary} (integers 0 <= a_c < n_c separated by spaces, in that order).

score: 1 for a difference set with these parameters in this group; none is known, so the best known value is 0
best_text: Its existence is Open in Gordon's repository: no such set is known and none has been ruled out, so the best known value is {best}; a valid set scores 1.
holder_sources: the repository's entry for these parameters and group
open_rule: every entry with status Open: one abelian group of one parameter set (v,k,lambda) (release 1.3 lists v up to 749,997)
left_out: 31551 entries known to exist (All or Yes), 951513 known not to exist (No), and 91 open entries whose check would take more than ten minutes in ds_check.py's C helper (check_seconds in tools/gordon_cells.py: k(k - 1) ordered pairs at the measured rate of the method the group allows)
